name: Sylas
description: Life in Dregbourne isn’t exactly generous to those living there. Before his years in prison, Sylas grew up knowing how to make a meal from whatever was available. Memory of his mother's cabbage and onion pot became one of the few comforts he carried with him into captivity. Pork was a rare luxury, usually saved for celebrations, but those were the meals Sylas remembered most during those excruciatingly long fifteen years. Now free from the chains that once bound him to that cell, the dish remains as a reminder of the life he once had, and the one Demacia took away from him.
ingredients: A little cooking oil or pork fat
Instructions: Brown the pork in a large pot.
Add onion and carrots; cook for a few minutes.
Add cabbage, barley, stock, thyme and bay leaf.
Bring to a simmer and cook covered for 60–75 min, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper.
Finish with a small splash of vinegar to brighten it up.
Notes: Add barley to make meal more filling.

name: Yorick
description: Being gifted from a young age, life was never easy on Yorick. However, being outcast for a long time, even before the Ruination, does help with loneliness of guiding lost souls. Even though his days at the Brethren of the Dusk are not something to remember with warmth and care, Yorick misses one thing, the food. It feels like a lifetime ago, but that specific chicken recipe… At least that was something to look forward to. And that Maiden following him everywhere? Not a healthy relationship.
Instructions: Season the chicken generously with salt and pepper.
Heat butter and oil in a large pan and brown the chicken on both sides, about 5–7 minutes. Remove it.
Add the onion and mushrooms. Cook for 5–7 minutes, until nicely browned.
Sprinkle the flour over them and stir for about 1 minute.
Pour in the white wine and scrape the browned bits from the bottom.
Add the stock, thyme and rosemary.
Return the chicken and simmer gently for 20 minutes, turning it once.
Remove the chicken temporarily and stir in the cream.
Simmer for 5 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Stir in the Parmesan.
Return the chicken and coat it generously in the sauce.
Finish with parsley and plenty of black pepper.
Notes: For all the monks out there, replace half of the chicken with white beans and serve with monastery made bread.

name: Caitlyn
description: No better snack to snap trap Yordles, or any Zaunite rapscallions. Alongside her reputation as an esteemed sheriff and excellent shot, Caitlyn is also a bona fide in the kitchen. Known, mainly by Vi, from her infamous cupcakes. The Kiramman family recipe has been in the family for generations and brought prosperity in countless elevenses. While now mainly enjoyed solely by Vi, these fancy cakes have almost abnormal ability to lure and deceive unassuming humans and creatures alike into well-placed traps.
Instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C
Beat the butter and sugar together for 34 minutes until light and fluffy
Beat in the eggs one at a time
Mix flour baking powder and salt separately
Fold the dry ingredients into the batter then add vanilla and milk
Divide between 12 cupcake cases filling each about ⅔ full
Bake for 1822 minutes until lightly golden and a toothpick comes out clean
Let them cool completely
For the cream whip the heavy cream with powdered sugar and vanilla until it starts becoming thick
Add the cream cheese and continue whipping until you have a firm pipeable white cream
Pipe a generous swirl onto each cupcake
Decorate to your liking
Notes: Decorate with cocktail cherries and/or powdered sugar
